```plato
    // The query point when it is inside, otherwise the query clamped to the box in
    // the box's own frame and mapped back to world.
    ClosestPoint(b: Box3D, point: Point3D): Point3D
    {
        var hx = b.Size.Width * 0.5;
        var hy = b.Size.Height * 0.5;
        var hz = b.Size.Depth * 0.5;
        var q = LocalOffset(b.Center, b.Orientation, point);
        var clamped = Vector3D(q.X.Clamp(-hx, hx), q.Y.Clamp(-hy, hy), q.Z.Clamp(-hz, hz));
        return b.Contains(point)
            ? point
            : b.Center + WorldOffset(b.Orientation, clamped);
    }
```

```plato
    // The query point when it lies in the capsule, otherwise the radial projection
    // onto the boundary from the nearest spine point.
    ClosestPoint(c: Capsule3D, point: Point3D): Point3D
    {
        var spine = ClosestPointOnSegment(c.A, c.B, point);
        var outward = spine.Between(point);
        return outward.MagnitudeSquared <= c.Radius.Square
            ? point
            : spine + outward.Normalize * c.Radius;
    }
```

```plato
    // The query projected onto the disk's plane, then pulled radially back to the
    // rim if it landed outside. Always lands ON the patch.
    ClosestPoint(d: Disk3D, point: Point3D): Point3D
    {
        var inPlane = PerpendicularComponent(d.Center.Between(point), d.Normal.Vector);
        var distance = inPlane.Magnitude;
        return d.Center + (distance <= d.Radius
            ? inPlane
            : inPlane * (d.Radius / distance));
    }
```

```plato
    // The query projected onto the triangle's plane when that projection lands
    // inside, otherwise the nearest point of the three edges. A degenerate
    // (collinear) triangle has no plane, so the edge branch takes over — its
    // projection test fails on the zero normal.
    ClosestPoint(t: Triangle3D, point: Point3D): Point3D
    {
        var n = t.TwiceVectorArea.Normalize;
        var projected = point - n * t.A.Between(point).Dot(n);
        return t.ContainsCoplanar(projected)
            ? projected
            : t.Points.ClosestPointOnChain(true, point);
    }
```

```plato
    // The query point when it lies in the ball, otherwise its radial projection
    // onto the sphere.
    ClosestPoint(s: Sphere, point: Point3D): Point3D
        => s.Contains(point)
        ? point
        : s.Center + s.Center.Between(point).Normalize * s.Radius;
```
